basic_details.job_title: MMDSL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 6 ICU Technician, Regional Coordinator and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Manager Equipment Maintenance, Regional Coordinator, ICU Technician
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

qualification.details: Qualification: | Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biomedical Instrumentation, Medical Equipment Technology or an equivalent relevant discipline from a recognised university or institution. Candidates with a Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics or Mechanical Engineering, with a specialisation or substantial relevant experience in medical equipment maintenance and healthcare technology management, may be considered. | Experience: | Minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience in biomedical engineering, medical equipment maintenance or healthcare technology management, preferably in a hospital or healthcare organisation. At least three (3) years in a supervisory or managerial capacity, responsible for equipment maintenance planning, technical team coordination and monitoring of maintenance operations. Demonstrated experience in managing Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), Comprehensive Maintenance Contracts (CMCs), equipment breakdowns, vendor performance and preventive maintenance programmes. | Added advantage: | Additional qualifications or professional certifications in healthcare technology management, medical equipment maintenance or biomedical asset management. Experience in managing medical equipment inventories, equipment lifecycle planning and maintenance reporting systems across multiple healthcare facilities. | Skills: sound technical knowledge of medical equipment maintenance and troubleshooting; coordination, planning and problem-solving; computer applications, data management and report preparation; communication and organisational skills. | Qualification: Master of Business Administration (MBA) from a recognised university or institution or related field. | Experience: Minimum 5–6 years of relevant experience in operations management, administration, project coordination, team management, or a related field. | Preferred: | Experience in healthcare operations, supply chain management, logistics, or government projects. Experience in managing field-level operations, coordinating multiple teams, and resolving operational challenges. Experience in stakeholder management, performance monitoring, and operational reporting. | Skills: problem-solving and decision-making; leadership, coordination and team management; communication and conflict resolution; analytical, planning and organisational skills; MS Office, particularly Word and Excel; and the ability to work in field-based and operational environments. | Essential qualifications, as printed: | B.Sc. in Critical Care Technology or Intensive Care Technology (a 3-year degree plus a 1-year mandatory clinical internship). Diploma or certificate in ICU Technology, Critical Care Technology, Anaesthesia Technology, or an equivalent relevant qualification from a recognized institution. Relevant training in the operation and handling of ICU equipments. | Preferred: Relevant experience in an ICU, critical care unit, or hospital setting. | Skills: knowledge of ICU equipments and basic critical care procedures; identifying and reporting equipment malfunctions; infection prevention, biomedical waste management and patient safety practices; teamwork; and prompt response in emergencies. The post requires the ability to work in shifts, including night shifts, weekends and holidays, as the hospital requires. | See the official notification (PDF) for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Scan all biodata and testimonials, including your CV or resume, into a single PDF file under 10MB.
Open the MMDSL online application form. Applications are accepted through this form only.
Fill in the form and submit softcopies of your bio-data, certificates and job experience.
Complete the submission by 4 pm on 10 November 2026.
Documents to upload: bio-data or CV/resume, certificates, job experience documents and testimonials.
Documents to carry if shortlisted: all relevant certificates and testimonials in original.

content_sections.heading: Duties of Each Post
content_sections.text: Plan and monitor preventive and corrective maintenance of medical equipment across designated healthcare facilities. Coordinate with facilities, Jr. Equipment engineers, suppliers and authorised service providers for timely servicing and repair. Monitor breakdowns, downtime, warranty coverage, AMCs and CMCs. Keep an updated equipment inventory and prepare periodic reports on equipment status and pending repairs. Coordinate inspections, calibration, performance assessments and safety checks. Recommend repair, replacement or condemnation of obsolete, non-functional or irreparable equipment. Give technical inputs for maintenance planning, budgeting, spare parts and service contracts. Make regular field visits to healthcare facilities and manage a team of Jr. Equipment Engineers. Oversee and coordinate MMDSL operations across the Garo Region, working under the State Manager. Make regular field visits to district hospitals, healthcare facilities, warehouses and other designated locations. Monitor the availability and distribution of medicines, medical supplies, equipment and other resources with the relevant divisions. Coordinate with Medical Superintendents, Medical Officers, hospital administrators and district officials. Resolve regional operational problems within delegated authority and escalate matters that need State Office intervention. Submit periodic reports and keep records of field visits, meetings, issues and follow-up actions. Maintain confidentiality of operational records, employee information and other official information. Assist doctors and nursing staff in delivering critical care, including during emergencies and resuscitation, within the scope of training. Operate, monitor and help maintain multiparameter monitors, ventilators, infusion and syringe pumps, suction apparatus and oxygen delivery systems, as per training and authorization. Assist in monitoring and recording vital signs as assigned by supervising clinical staff. Prepare beds, equipment and supplies for new admissions and emergency cases. Clean, disinfect and store equipment according to infection prevention and control protocols, and follow biomedical waste guidelines. Report shortages, malfunctions, safety hazards and incidents, and maintain equipment logs. The ICU Technician works under the designated medical officer, ICU in-charge, nursing in-charge or other authorized hospital personnel, as applicable.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications go through a screening process constituted for the purpose. Candidates may have to undergo a written and/or practical test. Shortlisted candidates attend an interview and produce all relevant certificates and testimonials in original. Candidates will be intimated in due course after screening. Future updates will be made known via appropriate channels.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on a contractual basis and is renewable. A selected ICU Technician will perform duties at the location assigned by MMDSL and must comply with hospital protocols, infection control measures and patient safety standards. The ICU Technician must work within the scope of their qualifications, training and authorization, and maintain discipline, confidentiality and punctuality throughout the engagement. The office may reject any or all applications without assigning any reason, and may cancel, extend or advertise the recruitment at its own discretion.

faq.question: Q1. Where are the 4 ICU Technician posts based?
faq.answer: All 4 ICU Technician posts are listed with Tura as the place of posting.

faq.question: Q2. Can a candidate with a Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering apply for the Manager post?
faq.answer: Such a candidate may be considered if they have a specialisation or substantial relevant experience in medical equipment maintenance and healthcare technology management.

faq.question: Q3. How much managerial experience does the Manager Equipment Maintenance post need?
faq.answer: The post needs at least three years in a supervisory or managerial capacity, within the minimum of five years of relevant professional experience the notice asks for.

faq.question: Q4. Can the experience requirement be relaxed?
faq.answer: Yes. The competent authority may relax the minimum years of experience if the number of candidates meeting the requirement is less.

faq.question: Q5. Do applicants have to be from Meghalaya?
faq.answer: The advertisement invites applications from citizens of Meghalaya and gives preference to candidates who are domiciles of the state.

faq.question: Q6. Is ICU experience compulsory for the ICU Technician post?
faq.answer: No. Relevant experience in an ICU, critical care unit or hospital setting will be preferred, but relevant training in operating and handling ICU equipments is listed as essential.

faq.question: Q7. Will ICU Technicians work night shifts?
faq.answer: Yes. The terms of reference ask for the ability to work in shifts, including night shifts, weekends and holidays, as required by the hospital.

faq.question: Q8. What is the file size limit for uploads?
faq.answer: All biodata and testimonials must be uploaded as a single PDF file smaller than 10MB.

faq.question: Q9. Who does the Regional Coordinator report to?
faq.answer: The Regional Coordinator works under the supervision of the State Manager and coordinates with the relevant divisions.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a test before the interview?
faq.answer: There may be. After screening, candidates may have to undergo a written and/or practical test.
